subject: [PATCH v8 29/30] mm: install PMD swap entries on swap-out

2026-10-02.patch_summary: This patch improves the handling of PMD-mapped anonymous huge pages (THPs) during swap-out operations. When a THP is swapped out, it was previously split into smaller mappings, which caused performance issues and unnecessary overhead. This patch introduces a new approach where a single PMD-level swap entry is installed for each contiguous run of slots in the swap cache, eliminating the need for splitting and reducing the number of faults during swap-in. The patch also updates various kernel components to support this new behavior, including the huge memory management code, rmap, vmscan, and vmstat.
